name: security-audit
description: Pre-adoption security audit of an open-source repository, MCP server, package or standalone script — nine adaptive phases (recon, exfiltration, secrets, code execution, MCP/AI risks, supply chain, controls, hidden behaviour), dual output as a terminal verdict plus a full report file. Every external tool is optional: Semgrep when it is on PATH, an IDE search surface when one is up, ripgrep otherwise.
